_format: Every piece of art this character needs besides the card portraits (those come from design/cards.json). kind picks the recipe in scripts/art_recipes.py (style references, prompt template, size, post-processing); where the files go comes from the kind (scripts/presmod.py KIND_OUTPUTS) unless the item lists its own "outputs" (paths relative to mod/, {id} = the character id). art = what to draw; {persona} = character.json art.persona. The prompts below are generic starting points made by scripts/new_character.py: give them the character's props and jokes before generating (docs/ART_PIPELINE.md). Add a relic, power or potion here when its class is added.

character.name: Character select button
character.art: a character select portrait bust of {persona}, three-quarter view, a wide confident toothy grin, sunlight glinting off his aviators, on a solid flat saturated royal indigo blue background

character.name: Character select screen
character.art: {persona} leaning back against a vintage green 1967 sports car on a rocky cliff on the right half of the frame, seen from a low angle, arms crossed with a confident grin, a faint red glow in his aviators, the dark tower of the Spire far away on the horizon under a starry navy night sky with a crescent moon. The left 40 percent of the image is calm dark sky with no subject, leaving room for menu text
